facts.text: Palestine includes the geographically separate West Bank and Gaza Strip.
Palestine is in the Middle East.
Arabic is the main language of communication.

culture.text: Bread commonly accompanies Palestinian meals, including foods such as hummus and falafel.

food.name: Knafeh
food.text: This sweet cheese dessert is soaked in syrup and topped with shredded pastry; Nablus is known for its version.
